name: How long does it typically take to build a custom outdoor barbecue island?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to build a custom outdoor barbecue island?

acceptedAnswer.text: The construction timeline for a custom outdoor barbecue island varies based on the design's complexity, material availability, and required site preparation. A straightforward project might take 2-4 weeks from ground-breaking to completion, while more intricate designs involving extensive utility runs or custom features could extend to 6-8 weeks or more. Our process at Hometelligent Inc. includes a detailed project schedule provided upfront, outlining key milestones from design approval to final installation. Permitting in cities like Berkeley or Dublin can also add several weeks to the overall project timeline, so we account for this early on.
acceptedAnswer.description: Construction typically takes 2-8 weeks, depending on complexity and features. Hometelligent Inc. provides a detailed project schedule, accounting for factors like permitting which can extend timelines.
